quests.title: Rishboland Tiger, Roaaar

dialogue.t: Golden Nara, Arakanta has heard so much about you. You are a good Nara. Will you play with Arakanta?
Arakanta's game is simple and fun! Listen to the rules, Nara...
Arakanta will summon a lot of Dendro particles, which are "Aranara" hiding in the circle. Nara is a big and powerful "Rishboland Tiger." Come and chase "Aranara"!
If the "Rishboland Tiger" catches all the Aranara in a short time, then Nara wins!
Good? Nara willing to play game with Arakanta now?
Good? Nara willing to play game with Arakanta now?
Nara didn't win... But it's okay, Arakanta will play with Nara again!
So much fun! Arakanta is very happy playing games with Golden Nara! And Nara is so fast! So amazing! Like a real tiger!
It is fun playing with other Aranara and real Rishboland Tigers, but playing with our new friend, our Nara friend, is even more fun!

dialogue.sit: Why would the Rishboland Tiger chase Aranara?

dialogue.t: The Rishboland Tiger and Aranara are friends, and friends play together. But Arakanta noticed that Nara are afraid of the Rishboland Tiger. That's why Arakanta came up with a new game for Festival Utsava!
Thank you, Nara. Here is an Aranara flower for Golden Nara!

quests.description: Seems that Arakanta wants to play Rishboland Tiger and Aranara.
